title: Plan a guest backup schedule check
summary: Prepare a check-mode plan for explicit backup jobs and timers; this neither runs a backup nor proves recoverability.

target.description: Explicit target name from the private CmdMesh environment

expected_results: A static check-mode plan bound to this recipe, operation metadata and private inputs
No provider, Ansible, Terraform or infrastructure change runs during planning

known_failures.summary: A timer or metric does not prove every expected guest is protected
next_checks: Compare expected guests, mounts and jobs with actual artifacts and last results
recovery: Keep missing coverage explicit and qualify an isolated restore before claiming recovery

known_failures.summary: A later apply can enable overdue jobs or prune retained archives
next_checks: Inspect named jobs, persistent timers, destination space and retention policy
recovery: Disable only the named schedule through its documented procedure; deleted archives are not restored by rollback

provenance.qualification: Local manifest, plan and role syntax contracts
limitations: No immediate backup or independent copy is created by planning
Bind mounts and application consistency require explicit separate coverage
